question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class agent-scoped web/tool credential contract here, and should it live under `agents.list[].tools.web` or a generic per-agent plugin/tool configuration surface?
rationale: The missing capability is real, but choosing the config location and precedence affects credential isolation, SecretRef resolution, plugin-owned config, docs, validation, and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Design generic per-agent plugin/tool config
options.body: Define one precedence and SecretRef contract covering plugin-owned webSearch configs and global `tools.web` before implementation.

options.title: Add only `agents.list[].tools.web`
options.body: This addresses the narrow issue fastest but risks a second credential source competing with plugin-owned webSearch config.

options.title: Keep credentials global
options.body: This keeps the config surface lean but leaves shared credential, billing, and rate-limit isolation unsolved for multi-agent installs.

recommendation.title: Design generic per-agent plugin/tool config
recommendation.body: Define one precedence and SecretRef contract covering plugin-owned webSearch configs and global `tools.web` before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is primarily about config and SecretRef boundary policy, and the available history ties this person to web-search SecretRef behavior.
